The focused durability suite passes 7/7; the 80-test access/budget/mutation/runner/promotion regression group passes; no production source beyond the two owned files changed.

Spec/quality reviewer actor ids are distinct from the task actor and from each other; invocation ids p7r2-t2-independent-spec-review-20260810 and p7r2-t2-independent-quality-review-20260810 are recorded; external usage is declared UNKNOWN in the completion report.
